fullExplanation.text: Understanding 1 Samuel: Canonical and Historical Setting

An independent Catholic study of 1 Samuel focused on prophecy, kingship, Saul, David, obedience, and anointing. Scripture, ecclesial teaching, historical testimony, and specialist research contribute different kinds of evidence. Canonical and Historical Context

1 Samuel belongs to the Catholic Old Testament and is grouped among the Historical Books. That canonical placement is a fact about the received Catholic Bible, while proposals about composition, date, sources, and historical reconstruction are scholarly judgments of differing probability. The themes named by the approved curriculum are prophecy, kingship, Saul, David, obedience, and anointing. A responsible context lesson keeps those categories apart and checks precise historical claims against book-specific scholarship before approval.
